Write code that extracts merchant, tax, total, and items from a receipt using a concrete provider.

If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Alibaba OCR invoice recognition:
  Service: Alibaba Cloud OCR invoice recognition
  SDK: alibabacloud_ocr_api
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognizeInvoice
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ocr

Option 2 — Azure DI prebuilt invoice:
  Service: Azure Document Intelligence prebuilt invoice
  SDK: azure-ai-documentintelligence
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: begin_analyze_document
  Setup hints: AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT, AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/document-intelligence/prebuilt/invoice

Option 3 — Mindee:
  Service: Mindee Invoice OCR
  SDK: mindee
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: parse, invoice
  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.mindee.com/docs/python-sdk

Option 4 — Document AI Invoice Parser:
  Service: Google Document AI processors
  SDK: google-cloud-documentai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: process_document
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/document-ai/docs/processors-list#processor_invoice-parser

Option 5 — Textract AnalyzeExpense:
  Service: Amazon Textract AnalyzeExpense
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: analyze_expense
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/API_AnalyzeExpense.html

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
```python
from mindee import Client, Document, Invoice
import os

def extract_receipt_info(image_path):
    """
    Extract merchant, tax, total, and items from a receipt using Mindee Invoice OCR.
    
    Args:
        image_path (str): Path to the receipt image file.
        
    Returns:
        dict: Extracted information including merchant, tax, total, and items.
    """
    # Initialize the Mindee client with API key from environment variable
    client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("MINDEE_API_KEY"))
    
    # Load and parse the document using Mindee's Invoice parser
    doc = Document.from_path(image_path)
    result = doc.parse(Invoice)

    # Extract relevant information from the parsed result
    merchant = result.inference.page[0].company_name if result.inference.page[0].company_name else None
    tax = result.inference.page[0].tax_amount if result.inference.page[0].tax_amount else None
    total = result.inference.page[0].total_amount if result.inference.page[0].total_amount else None
    
    # Extract line items
    items = []
    for item in result.inference.page[0].items:
        item_dict = {
            "description": item.description if item.description else None,
            "quantity": item.quantity if item.quantity else None,
            "unit_price": item.unit_price if item.unit_price else None,
            "total_price": item.total_price if item.total_price else None
        }
        items.append(item_dict)
    
    return {
        "merchant": merchant,
        "tax": tax,
        "total": total,
        "items": items
    }
```
